_comment: The standing improvement structure (docs/model_program.md, section 7). Two tracks, each a list of measures with a target and a date:
depth: how complete and well sourced the record is (the pipeline: sources, extractors, county checks, verification, dates).
breadth: how widely the models are tested and how far they have reached (the Headwind Model's inputs, challengers and stages; the cost model's parity).

scripts/improvement_scorecard.py grades every measure once a month (met, on pace or behind), adds one row per measure to data/model/improvement_history.csv, and lists the measures that are behind with the routine that moves each one. A measure behind on two grades in a row opens an issue. No step waits on a person.

A measure is one entry with a kind the script knows: csv_share, csv_count, csv_distinct_share, json_value, json_fills_share, file_exists. A new measure, place or technology is configuration; the stage targets of each model stay in config/model_program.json.

Pace: a milestone (a yes or no measure) is due on its date and is behind only after it. Any other measure is on pace when its value is at least where a straight line from its first graded value to its target on its target date would put it today. lower_is_better turns every comparison around.
